workflowDefinition.name: SOC Detection Eval (Argus M2.1)
workflowDefinition.description:
Argus Detection Eval Vertical — POLLER for @kbn/evals results.
The actual evaluation (precision / recall / fp_rate / variant_coverage) runs inside the Playwright-driven `kbn-evals-suite-argus-detection` package. That suite writes one row per rule per run into `.soc-detection-eval-runs` via the Elasticsearch bulk API. This workflow does NOT call a Kibana HTTP endpoint, and it does NOT score anything itself — that belongs in the suite, where the rule replay is deterministic, source-controlled, and test-covered.
Responsibilities owned here:

  * Poll `.soc-detection-eval-runs` for NEW results since the last tick.
  * For each new row, reconcile the matching `.soc-recommendations`
    entry (if one exists) by updating `status` and `eval_gate_decision`
    based on the row's `gate_decision`. This closes the loop with the
    `soc-autonomous-applier` that reads `auto_apply_ready`.
  * Emit a heartbeat for the activity feed so demo operators can watch
    the eval cadence.
  * Emit an Argus governance trace (argus.decision.kind=rule_eval) per
    tick so `.soc-reasoning-trace` contains the eval verdicts alongside
    the triage and deteng decisions.

This split keeps the expensive rule replay inside `@kbn/evals` (which owns the Playwright runner, ES client, and cluster state) and keeps the workflow engine doing what it does best: consuming indexed results and driving downstream state changes.
Triggers:
  * scheduled 2m  : frequent polling so the demo shows near-real-time reconciliation
  * manual        : demo operators can force a sweep

with.message: Argus detection-eval poll complete — reconciled {{ steps.fetch_new_eval_runs.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} new eval-run row(s) (tick deteval-tick-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }})

_source.yaml:
version: '1'
name: SOC Detection Eval (Argus M2.1)
description: >
  Argus Detection Eval Vertical — POLLER for @kbn/evals results.

  The actual evaluation (precision / recall / fp_rate / variant_coverage)
  runs inside the Playwright-driven `kbn-evals-suite-argus-detection`
  package. That suite writes one row per rule per run into
  `.soc-detection-eval-runs` via the Elasticsearch bulk API. This workflow
  does NOT call a Kibana HTTP endpoint, and it does NOT score anything
  itself — that belongs in the suite, where the rule replay is
  deterministic, source-controlled, and test-covered.

  Responsibilities owned here:

    * Poll `.soc-detection-eval-runs` for NEW results since the last tick.
    * For each new row, reconcile the matching `.soc-recommendations`
      entry (if one exists) by updating `status` and `eval_gate_decision`
      based on the row's `gate_decision`. This closes the loop with the
      `soc-autonomous-applier` that reads `auto_apply_ready`.
    * Emit a heartbeat for the activity feed so demo operators can watch
      the eval cadence.
    * Emit an Argus governance trace (argus.decision.kind=rule_eval) per
      tick so `.soc-reasoning-trace` contains the eval verdicts alongside
      the triage and deteng decisions.

  This split keeps the expensive rule replay inside `@kbn/evals` (which
  owns the Playwright runner, ES client, and cluster state) and keeps the
  workflow engine doing what it does best: consuming indexed results and
  driving downstream state changes.

  Triggers:
    * scheduled 2m  : frequent polling so the demo shows near-real-time reconciliation
    * manual        : demo operators can force a sweep

enabled: true

triggers:
  - type: scheduled
    with:
      every: 2m
  - type: manual

consts:
  runs_index: ".soc-detection-eval-runs"
  recs_index: ".soc-recommendations"
  # 15m lookback — long enough to survive a missed tick, short enough to
  # stay bounded. Rows already reconciled are filtered out by the
  # `reconciled: true` flag so duplicate processing is a no-op.
  poll_window: "now-15m"

steps:
  # ── Poll for unreconciled eval runs ─────────────────────────────────
  # elasticsearch.request (not .search) so we can use object-form sort
  # on @timestamp — the engine's .search schema rejects it.
  - name: fetch_new_eval_runs
    type: elasticsearch.request
    with:
      method: POST
      path: "/{{ consts.runs_index }}/_search"
      body:
        size: 50
        sort:
          - "@timestamp":
              order: asc
        query:
          bool:
            filter:
              - range:
                  "@timestamp":
                    gte: "{{ consts.poll_window }}"
            must_not:
              - term:
                  reconciled: true

  # ── Per-run reconciliation ──────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: reconcile
    type: foreach
    foreach: "{{ steps.fetch_new_eval_runs.output.hits.hits }}"
    steps:
      # Look up the source recommendation (if any). The suite may emit
      # runs for rules that came from a coverage gap without a rec doc;
      # in that case, the lookup returns zero hits and we just skip the
      # update step.
      - name: find_source_rec
        type: elasticsearch.search
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.recs_index }}"
          size: 1
          query:
            bool:
              filter:
                - term: { "details.artifact_type": "rule" }
                - term: { "details.patch.rule_id": "{{ foreach.item._source.rule_id }}" }

      - name: has_source_rec_gate
        type: console
        with:
          message: >-
            {%- assign _n = steps.find_source_rec.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 -%}
            {% if _n > 0 %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

      - name: update_source_rec
        type: elasticsearch.update
        if: "steps.has_source_rec_gate.output: yes"
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.recs_index }}"
          id: "{{ steps.find_source_rec.output.hits.hits[0]._id }}"
          doc:
            eval_completed_at: "{{ foreach.item._source['@timestamp'] }}"
            eval_run_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.run_id }}"
            eval_gate_decision: "{{ foreach.item._source.gate_decision | default: 'marginal' }}"
            eval_scores: "{{ foreach.item._source.scores | default: empty }}"
            status: "{% assign _gd = foreach.item._source.gate_decision | default: 'marginal' %}{% if _gd == 'pass' %}auto_apply_ready{% elsif _gd == 'fail' %}blocked_eval{% else %}pending_review{% endif %}"

      # Mark the eval-run row as reconciled so the next poll skips it.
      - name: mark_run_reconciled
        type: elasticsearch.update
        with:
          index: "{{ consts.runs_index }}"
          id: "{{ foreach.item._id }}"
          doc:
            reconciled: true
            reconciled_at: "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            reconciled_tick: "deteval-tick-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"

      # Argus M2.5 — emit a governance span per reconciled eval run. The
      # decision_kind="rule_eval" is the distinguishing signal that lets
      # the governance dashboard separate eval verdicts from triage and
      # deteng decisions when slicing by agent+decision_kind.
      - name: write_eval_reasoning_trace
        type: elasticsearch.index
        with:
          index: .soc-reasoning-trace
          document:
            "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
            run_id: "{{ foreach.item._source.run_id }}"
            agent_id: "soc-detection-eval"
            step_index: 0
            step_type: "run_summary"
            content: "Rule {{ foreach.item._source.rule_id }} → gate={{ foreach.item._source.gate_decision | default: 'marginal' }} precision={{ foreach.item._source.scores.precision | default: 0 }} recall={{ foreach.item._source.scores.recall | default: 0 }}"
            argus:
              agent:
                id: "soc-detection-eval"
                version: "argus-m2.5"
              decision:
                kind: "rule_eval"
                id: "{{ foreach.item._source.run_id }}"
                confidence: "{{ foreach.item._source.scores.precision | default: 0 }}"
              actor:
                trust_tier: "scoped"
            attributes:
              argus.agent.id: "soc-detection-eval"
              argus.agent.version: "argus-m2.5"
              argus.decision.kind: "rule_eval"
              argus.decision.id: "{{ foreach.item._source.run_id }}"
              argus.decision.confidence: "{{ foreach.item._source.scores.precision | default: 0 }}"
              argus.actor.trust_tier: "scoped"

  # ── Heartbeat + tick summary ────────────────────────────────────────
  - name: heartbeat
    type: elasticsearch.index
    with:
      index: .soc-audit-trail
      document:
        "@timestamp": "{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%LZ' }}"
        event_type: argus_detection_eval_tick
        source: "soc-detection-eval"
        tick_id: "deteval-tick-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }}"
        runs_reconciled: "{{ steps.fetch_new_eval_runs.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }}"

  - name: log_done
    type: console
    with:
      message: "Argus detection-eval poll complete — reconciled {{ steps.fetch_new_eval_runs.output.hits.hits | size | default: 0 }} new eval-run row(s) (tick deteval-tick-{{ execution.startedAt | date: '%Y%m%d%H%M%S' }})"
